items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember walking in there. I‟d never seen so many drums, these guys that I didn‟t know.

ctx.x: Modesto Duran? Carlos Vidal? Luis Miranda?

Yeah, Modesto. He might have been from San Francisco. I‟m not sure. Anyway, some of them had played with Kenton‟s band. Carlos Vidal had been with Kenton. They probably recommended some of their friends. I remember walking in there. I‟d never seen so many drums, these guys that I didn‟t know.
So that‟s what you remember from the date.
